title: Junie — Agentic Coding Cheat Sheet
brandSub: IDE · CLI · Headless CI/CD · GitHub Actions · GitLab CI

rows.label: What it is
rows.value: Coding agent for delegated engineering work — not just AI chat

rows.label: Runs in
rows.value: JetBrains IDEs, interactive terminal (CLI), headless CI/CD

rows.label: Install (Linux/macOS)
rows.value: curl -fsSL https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.sh | bash

rows.label: Install (Windows)
rows.value: iex (irm 'https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.ps1') via PowerShell

rows.label: Launch
rows.value: Run junie from the project root directory

rows.label: Verify version
rows.value: junie --version

rows.label: Auth options
rows.value: JetBrains Account, JUNIE_API_KEY token, or BYOK provider key

rows.label: Generate API key
rows.value: Visit junie.jetbrains.com/cli to generate your JUNIE_API_KEY

rows.label: Plan Mode
rows.value: Read-only codebase analysis → design doc before any edits; see Plan Mode section

rows.label: Hooks (EAP)
rows.value: Shell commands on session lifecycle events (SessionStart, PreToolUse, Stop…); see Project Guidelines

rows.label: Git Worktrees
rows.value: Isolate parallel sessions in separate checkouts via /worktree; see Sessions & Worktrees

rows.label: Remote Mode
rows.value: Continue CLI session in browser via /remote; see Sessions & Worktrees

rows.label: Brave Mode levels
rows.value: Off / Auto / On — cycle with /brave or Ctrl+B; see Privacy & Security

rows.label: Model & Effort
rows.value: Runtime model + reasoning effort selection via /model and /effort; see Models & Auth

rows.label: ACP support
rows.value: Run Junie CLI as an Agent Client Protocol server with --acp true

rows.label: Debug Mode
rows.value: Live debugger assistant via /debug (IDE connection required); see IDE Integration

rows.label: Agent loop
rows.value: Prompt → plan → multi-file edits → commands → verification → summary

rows.label: Good task shape
rows.value: Bounded, self-contained work with a clear success condition

rows.label: @ attach
rows.value: Type @ in the prompt to attach the smallest useful file, folder, or symbol

rows.label: Image input
rows.value: Drag-and-drop PNG/JPEG screenshots or design specs directly into the terminal prompt

rows.label: Real-time follow-up
rows.value: Type clarifications while Junie is working — appended immediately to the in-flight task

rows.label: Review changes
rows.value: After task completes, selectively accept or roll back file-by-file in the Done panel

rows.label: Shell passthrough
rows.value: Prefix with ! to run a shell command without leaving Junie CLI (e.g. !git log)

rows.label: Primary file
rows.value: .junie/AGENTS.md — persistent project context read on every task

rows.label: Fallback path
rows.value: AGENTS.md in project root if no .junie/AGENTS.md exists

rows.label: Custom path
rows.value: Override via IDE Settings → Tools → Junie → Project Settings

rows.label: config.json (user)
rows.value: ~/.junie/config.json — personal defaults (model, brave, hooks…)

rows.label: config.json (project)
rows.value: .junie/config.json — shared team defaults checked into VCS

rows.label: Hooks config
rows.value: Add hooks key to ~/.junie/config.json; project-scope hooks ignored by default

rows.label: Hooks events
rows.value: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, Stop, StopFailure, PermissionRequest, SessionEnd

rows.label: Extra config files
rows.value: --config-location /path/to/config.json — stack multiple files

rows.label: Multi-file edits
rows.value: Reads, creates, and modifies files across the project in a single task

rows.label: Runs commands
rows.value: Executes shell commands (build, test, lint) as part of the task loop

rows.label: Verification
rows.value: Runs tests and inspections to confirm changes before finishing

rows.label: IDE-backed search
rows.value: Symbol-aware search, class/method completions when JetBrains IDE is connected

rows.label: Code mode
rows.value: Default — full edits, commands, test execution with progress reporting

rows.label: Ask mode
rows.value: Read-only: explore, analyze, brainstorm without modifying files

rows.label: Subagents
rows.value: Main agent auto-delegates to specialized subagents stored in .junie/agents/*.md

rows.label: Custom commands
rows.value: Extend Junie CLI with custom slash commands for repetitive prompts

rows.label: Command menu
rows.value: Type / in the prompt to browse all slash commands

rows.label: Shortcut help
rows.value: Type ? to list all keyboard shortcuts

rows.label: Prompt history
rows.value: Ctrl+R to search history; Up/Down to navigate results

rows.label: Transcript view
rows.value: Ctrl+O to open full session transcript; Ctrl+N for older entries

rows.label: Run headless
rows.value: junie --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" "Fix failing tests"

rows.label: All options
rows.value: junie --help lists every flag and environment variable

rows.label: ACP mode
rows.value: junie --acp true to serve ACP-compatible editors (e.g. VS Code with ACP)

rows.label: Auto-update
rows.value: Set "auto-update": true in config.json to enable automatic update checks

rows.label: Toggle
rows.value: Shift+Tab shortcut or /plan slash command

rows.label: Inline prompt
rows.value: /plan refactor commands — enables Plan Mode and submits immediately

rows.label: CLI flag
rows.value: junie --plan or junie --prompt "…" --plan

rows.label: Plan view
rows.value: Ctrl+P to open full design doc split into Requirements / Technical design / Testing / Delivery steps tabs

rows.label: Iterate
rows.value: Adjust scope and push back before confirming — plan is a living doc

rows.label: Confirm & implement
rows.value: Choose Confirm and implement to hand off plan to the coding agent

rows.label: Save & stop
rows.value: Choose Save the plan and stop to keep Markdown plan on disk without implementing

rows.label: Open AI Chat
rows.value: AI Chat tool window is part of the AI Assistant plugin in JetBrains IDEs

rows.label: Select Junie
rows.value: Choose Junie by JetBrains from the coding agents list in AI Chat

rows.label: Agents mode
rows.value: Full agentic execution — edits, commands, verification — inside the IDE

rows.label: Ask mode (IDE)
rows.value: Read-only chat; use mode picker dropdown, or select Auto for automatic mode choice

rows.label: Context attach
rows.value: Click the + button on the prompt panel to attach files or create .aiignore

rows.label: Diff viewer
rows.value: Click file links in Junie's task window to open code changes in the IDE diff viewer

rows.label: Done panel
rows.value: Review changed files and selectively revert before accepting the result

rows.label: /review
rows.value: Opens wizard: From Main / Last Commit / Unstaged Changes

rows.label: Custom scope
rows.value: /review focusing on performance and memory leaks — free-text instructions

rows.label: [CRITICAL]
rows.value: Security vulnerabilities, crashes, data-loss issues are prefixed [CRITICAL]

rows.label: Apply suggestion
rows.value: Accept or dismiss findings one-by-one or in bulk from the review results screen

rows.label: Headless review
rows.value: junie --auth="$KEY" --review "Check for null pointer exceptions"

rows.label: Requires git
rows.value: /review only starts when a .git directory is detected in the project

rows.label: Follow-ups
rows.value: Review runs as its own session — ask follow-ups without re-explaining context

rows.label: Human gate
rows.value: Always keep humans in the PR/MR approval path for production changes

rows.label: /model
rows.value: Interactive model picker — also sets reasoning effort level for the session

rows.label: /effort
rows.value: Change only the effort level: minimal / low / medium / high / xhigh / max

rows.label: Env vars
rows.value: JUNIE_MODEL, JUNIE_EFFORT, JUNIE_LLM_PROVIDER set defaults for new sessions

rows.label: Model aliases
rows.value: sonnet, opus, gpt, gemini-pro, gemini-flash, grok, gpt-codex

rows.label: BYOK providers
rows.value: anthropic, openai, google, xai, openrouter — set in /account or config.json

rows.label: BYOK + JB account
rows.value: BYOK can stack with JetBrains Account; BYOK provider is billed directly for that model

rows.label: /usage
rows.value: Shows token cost breakdown, model used, and remaining balance for the session

rows.label: Default model
rows.value: Keep Default for best price-quality; raise effort only when a task clearly benefits

rows.label: /mcp
rows.value: Opens MCP server list with status; press Ctrl+A to launch MCP Installation Assistant

rows.label: Project config
rows.value: .junie/mcp/mcp.json — shared with team via VCS (avoid secrets in this file)

rows.label: User config
rows.value: ~/.junie/mcp/mcp.json — available across all projects, private to your account

rows.label: Max tools
rows.value: Junie supports up to 100 tools across all configured MCP servers

rows.label: OAuth servers
rows.value: Remote MCP servers with OAuth show Authorization required; authorize via /mcp menu

rows.label: Extensions
rows.value: /extensions installs bundles of skills + MCP + subagents from marketplace

rows.label: Built-in marketplace
rows.value: github.com/JetBrains/junie-extensions — Java, Kotlin, Android, Spring Boot, SQL…

rows.label: Custom marketplace
rows.value: Register any git repo or marketplace.json URL via Extensions → Marketplaces tab

rows.label: Auth flag
rows.value: --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" — required for non-interactive runs

rows.label: Positional prompt
rows.value: junie --auth="$KEY" "Fix any failing tests"

rows.label: --review flag
rows.value: junie --auth="$KEY" --review reviews latest changes without the TUI wizard

rows.label: --plan flag
rows.value: junie --plan --prompt "Refactor commands module" outputs a plan, no edits

rows.label: Extra config
rows.value: --config-location /opt/company/junie.json for CI-specific settings

rows.label: Disable defaults
rows.value: --config-default-locations false to skip user & project config.json

rows.label: Time limit
rows.value: Set "time-limit": 3600 in config.json to cap task duration in seconds

rows.label: Env var auth
rows.value: JUNIE_API_KEY env var is equivalent to --auth for CI pipelines

rows.label: Action ref
rows.value: JetBrains/junie-github-action@v0 — runs entirely on your GitHub runners

rows.label: @junie-agent trigger
rows.value: Comment @junie-agent <task> in any issue or PR to invoke the agent

rows.label: Required permissions
rows.value: contents: write, pull-requests: write, issues: write

rows.label: BYOK in Actions
rows.value: Use anthropic_api_key, openai_api_key, etc. instead of junie_api_key

rows.label: Custom guidelines
rows.value: junie_guidelines_filename input overrides default AGENTS.md for GitHub runs

rows.label: MCP in Actions
rows.value: allowed_mcp_servers: "mcp_github_checks_server" to analyze failed CI checks

rows.label: Output: pr_url
rows.value: steps.junie.outputs.pr_url — URL of the PR created by the agent

rows.label: Silent mode
rows.value: silent_mode: true — dry run with no commits, branches, or comments posted

rows.label: #junie trigger
rows.value: Comment #junie <task> in an issue or MR to trigger a CI pipeline run

rows.label: MR review
rows.value: Tag #junie code-review on an existing MR to request a targeted review

rows.label: Auto-review
rows.value: Junie reviews every opened MR automatically; disable by unchecking MR events in webhook

rows.label: GITLAB_TOKEN_FOR_JUNIE
rows.value: Personal or group access token with Maintainer role + api scope

rows.label: Custom prompt
rows.value: Set JUNIE_CUSTOM_PROMPT in .gitlab-ci.yml to override auto-review instructions

rows.label: Parallel tasks
rows.value: Multiple issues/MRs can be worked simultaneously; same-branch parallel runs are excluded

rows.label: Webhook setup
rows.value: Init pipeline in Junie's container project creates webhooks and access tokens automatically

rows.label: Self-managed
rows.value: Works with both GitLab.com (SaaS) and self-managed GitLab instances

rows.label: Supported IDEs
rows.value: IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, RubyMine, RustRover, CLion, Rider

rows.label: Min version
rows.value: 2024.3.2+ for IDEA Ultimate/PyCharm Pro/WebStorm/GoLand; 2025.1+ for others

rows.label: Install plugin
rows.value: Search Junie in IDE Marketplace, or select it from AI Chat agent list

rows.label: /ide
rows.value: Inspect IDE connection state, switch between projects, install missing plugin

rows.label: IDE states
rows.value: Connected / Connecting / Auth required / Missing / Unsupported

rows.label: /debug
rows.value: Toggle Debug Mode: Shift+Tab+Tab or /debug — requires active JetBrains IDE debug session

rows.label: Debug actions
rows.value: Set breakpoints, inspect variables, evaluate expressions, step through code via live debugger

rows.label: .aiignore
rows.value: Create .aiignore (gitignore syntax) to require approval before Junie reads sensitive files

rows.label: /new
rows.value: Start another live session; current session keeps running in background

rows.label: /new <prompt>
rows.value: /new update the tests for payment flow — opens session with prompt prefilled

rows.label: /history
rows.value: Switch between live sessions or resume saved sessions; press Tab to filter by project

rows.label: Session storage
rows.value: Last 10 sessions stored with full LLM usage data and prompt/response history

rows.label: /worktree
rows.value: Create or switch to a Git worktree so parallel sessions don't overwrite each other

rows.label: Worktree naming
rows.value: Auto-named <project>-junie-wt-01, -wt-02… as siblings of the project directory

rows.label: /remote
rows.value: Open current CLI session in browser at junie.jetbrains.com/remote

rows.label: Remote limits
rows.value: Slash commands, ! shell prefix, and @ picker are terminal-only; BYOK-only auth not supported

rows.label: Approval model
rows.value: Sensitive actions (terminal commands, MCP tools, files outside project) require explicit approval

rows.label: Action Allowlist
rows.value: Select Always allow at an approval prompt; stored in ~/.junie/allowlist.json

rows.label: Brave Off
rows.value: Approves only Allowlisted commands; most conservative — recommended default

rows.label: Brave Auto
rows.value: Classifies terminal commands; auto-approves safe ones, prompts for risky or unrecognized

rows.label: Brave On
rows.value: Executes all potentially sensitive actions without approval — use with caution

rows.label: Toggle brave
rows.value: /brave slash command or Ctrl+B shortcut to cycle through levels

rows.label: Hooks safety
rows.value: Project-scope hooks in .junie/config.json are ignored unless passed via --config-location

rows.label: BYOK privacy
rows.value: BYOK keys route requests directly to your provider; no JetBrains AI credits consumed

rows.label: Start bounded
rows.value: Give Junie a single, verifiable outcome; break large features into sequential tasks

rows.label: Plan first
rows.value: Use Plan Mode on complex work to align on scope before any code is written

rows.label: Smallest context
rows.value: Attach only the files directly relevant — noise in context degrades output quality

rows.label: Explicit validation
rows.value: Include the exact test command and expected output in your prompt for clear success criteria

rows.label: Prompt history
rows.value: Reuse successful prompts via Ctrl+R — prompt history persists across all sessions

rows.label: Subagent tip
rows.value: Keep delegated work items independent; ask for specific outputs (file paths, symbol names)

rows.label: Version-sensitive
rows.value: CLI flags and Action inputs are version-sensitive — pin action ref when possible

rows.label: Human in the loop
rows.value: Delegate execution to Junie; keep humans in the PR/MR approval gate for production
